notes:
Inbound SMB lead from support automation space. Product: SurgeAssist Cloudware - lightweight customer support automation for SMBs (help centers, ticket triage, auto-summaries).

Customer needs / ask: integrate Redwood Hosted API as an embeddable summarization + action layer inside their agent UI. Primary flows: (1) ticket summarization (short bullet TL;DR + structured metadata), (2) tool-calling to perform triage actions (send follow-up, escalate, set priority) using function calls, (3) structured output for downstream downstream indexing and ticket fields.

Performance & scale: typical tenancy is 20-30 req/s during business hours for a single customer; target end-to-end summary latency < 500ms for single-ticket summarization (most tickets short). Cost sensitivity high: SMB pricing required; looking for guidance on batching and cache to reduce per-ticket unit cost.

Model & routing preferences: prefer open-model variants (quantized) to control costs; want automatic fallback to cheaper model during spikes. Interested in Redwood model catalog recommendations + quantization guidance (ask to include Optimize suggestions).

Security / compliance: must support SSO (SAML) for their admin console; audit logging and ability to limit data retention (prefer 90-day retention for cached summaries). No air-gapped / on-prem requirement — public cloud hosted API acceptable. SOC2 expected since they resell to SMBs.

Quote from engineering lead: "We need something that just works out of the box for our self-serve customers — minimal ops. If Hosted API can give predictable latency and clear cost levers, we can flip it on in 2 weeks."

POC ask: 2-week self-serve POC on Hosted API with 100k tokens included, sample prompt templates for ticket summarization + tool-calling examples, and a short integration guide describing recommended batching/cache settings.

Sales notes: early-stage discovery -> good fit for Hosted API self-serve. Provide quickstart + example code (node/python) and a short pricing comparison vs current vendor (Intercom agents API). Main open items: SAML timing, exact retention/legal language, token cap for POC.

Action items (AE / SE): send quickstart + pricing deck, upload POC config template to Drive, schedule kickoff 30m POC call wk of 3/16, create RDW-4521 ticket to track SAML question.
